correctness.rationale: On C_n² with n>=5, the closed five-site minority rule flips exactly when cut gain is nonnegative. In bond variables z_i=1_{x_i=x_{i+1}}, parity Σz_i≡n (mod 2) gives exactly two spin lifts and C=n+Z−2J. Exhaustive four-bond algebra gives local cut change ΔC and shows paired adjacent 1-bonds can be removed without loss, while hard-core slides and 00000→01100→01010 can raise any deficient independent bond state by two. Thus every configuration reaches a global maximum cut with positive-probability finite path, eliminating nonoptimal closed classes. Counting independent k_n-subsets plus residue-one adjacent-pair extras yields R_n=4,n(n²+23)/12,n²/2,2n in residues 0,1,2,3; neutral slides and explicit lift-complementing bond loops prove one irreducible class except when n≡0 mod 4, where four configurations are frozen. Symmetric neutral transition rates imply uniform stationary law. Finite n=5..13 graph checks corroborate but do not replace the all-n connectivity/loop proof.
